# Audio Credits
Nocturne ships with generated procedural beds and may include curated CC0/user-owned ambience loops. CC0 does not require attribution, but Nocturne credits sources anyway.

- **Soft Rain Noise** — `/sounds/soft-rain-noise.wav`; generated locally by `scripts/generate_noise.py`.
